description: Ministry of City Planning & Water Supply - Order to acquire the land in Dickwella D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the approval of servitude rights for a specific land parcel (Dickellawaththa) for water infrastructure purposes. It includes detailed land description, boundaries, and claimant information, fitting the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the core land transaction purpose rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
